findings.title: Palestinian detainee groups report that two Gaza women remain detained after return from treatment abroad; mother has not resumed chemotherapy
findings.publisher: Palestine News and Information Agency (WAFA), citing Commission of Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs and Palestinian Prisoner's Society
findings.location: Amal and Yasmin al-Rifi from Gaza Strip; detained on return from Egypt on 2026-10-20; transferred from Ashkelon to Damon Prison on 2026-10-29, Israel
findings.affected_population_system: Reportedly detained Gaza women Amal al-Rifi (60) and daughter Yasmin (33). Detainee organizations say Amal has cancer and missed her scheduled fifth chemotherapy session on October 21 following detention on October 20, with treatment still not resumed as of November 10. Details attributed to detainee advocates and their legal visit; no independent medical records verified.

findings.source_type: Established Palestinian national news agency relaying named detainee-rights organizations' joint statement

bounded_discovery_context.novel_evidence: Detainees' names and ages, reported detention while returning from Egyptian care, chemotherapy interruption, present medical-access warning.
bounded_discovery_context.deduplication: Not a new arrest on November 10; report concerns detention dating to October 20 and a new dated assessment of continuing interrupted care; separate from Gaza casualty events.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: Claim is attributed to detainee-rights organizations through WAFA and corroborated as same organizational statement by Palestinian Information Center; Israeli prison or medical records not independently verified.
